The '''Mission to Pembric II''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pembric II]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. During the mission, the command crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' ran afoul of the local crime lord, [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]].
